node.statement: Parse KEY=VALUE config lines: split on first '=', retain subsequent '=', reject empty key or missing delimiter, add no dependency unless required.
node.title: Config line parser behavior
node.proposed_mechanism: A parsing package, proposed by the request and not yet decided.
node.required_behavior: Return key and value for a well-formed line; reject lines with an empty key or no delimiter observably.

node.statement: Explore stdlib first-delimiter parsing, JSON input representation, and environment boundary mechanisms.
node.title: Config parser mechanism space

node.statement: Use native String.indexOf and String.slice inside the parser function boundary without dependencies.
node.title: Standard library first delimiter parsing

node.statement: Change input specification to standard JSON format instead of KEY=VALUE lines.
node.title: JSON representation change

node.statement: Delegate config parsing to process environment variable input boundaries.
node.title: Environment input boundary delegation

node.statement: Hard filter: JSON breaks format compatibility; env boundary changes interface ownership. CAN-first-delimiter-stdlib selected provisionally.
node.title: Candidate evaluation and hard requirement filtering

adversarial_critique.attack: JSON breaks compatibility with existing KEY=VALUE contract
adversarial_critique.response: Rejected before preference scoring; a failed hard requirement is ineligible regardless of cost.
Rejected before preference scoring; ownership moves outside the function contract.

adversarial_critique.attack: Stdlib splitting may miss encoding or locale variants
adversarial_critique.response: The format contract is raw ASCII KEY=VALUE with no encoding rules, so native slicing suffices and adds zero mutable state; a future encoding requirement would falsify this selection.

node.statement: Require Rung 3 Algorithmic logic assertion check covering 4 deterministic test cases.
node.title: Algorithmic validation for config line parser

node.statement: Node assertion check passed all 4 deterministic parser cases at Rung 3.
node.title: Rung 3 Algorithmic logic assertion receipt

node.statement: Lock CAN-first-delimiter-stdlib based on verified Rung 3 algorithmic evidence receipt EVD-config-line-parser-r3.
node.title: Lock stdlib first-delimiter config line parser
node.adversarial_critique: Attack: locking on four unit cases may hide malformed-input classes like whitespace-only keys or CRLF endings. Response: those inputs are outside the stated format contract; if the contract widens, the falsification condition is any accepted line that violates key-nonempty or first-delimiter behavior, which reopens this decision.
